overview.zh: HEIDENHAIN 起源于1889年柏林金属蚀刻企业，1948年在Traunreut重新设立。公司为电机反馈、机器人输出侧测量及精密定位提供光学和感应式测量部件，不是机器人整机制造商。
overview.en: HEIDENHAIN originated as a Berlin metal-etching company in 1889 and restarted in Traunreut in 1948. It supplies optical and inductive measurement components for motor feedback, robot output-side measurement and precision positioning, rather than complete robots.

overview.zh: 机器人业务需区分单圈、多圈、电机侧、减速器输出侧，以及安全型与非安全型。KCI120 Dplus把两侧位置读数组合在一个系统内；ECI/EQI EnDat3料号不能与旧EnDat2.2件混用。
overview.en: Robotics selection distinguishes singleturn/multiturn, motor/output side, and safety/non-safety variants. KCI120 Dplus combines both position measurements in one system; ECI/EQI EnDat3 items must not be confused with legacy EnDat2.2 items.

overview.zh: 官方历史记录1970年设立非营利基金会、2019年纳入所有者控股公司DIADUR SE。本次没有获得可核验的机器人分部营收或完整最新合并财报，不推导估值或融资轮。
overview.en: Official history records a nonprofit foundation in 1970 and integration into the owner holding company DIADUR SE in 2019. This review did not obtain verifiable robotics-segment revenue or complete current consolidated accounts; no valuation or financing round is inferred.

catalogScope.zh: 核查EnDat3 ECI1319/EQI1331四料号及附件、2021 KCI1319/KBI1335、2023 KCI120/KBI136和一种KCI120 Dplus版本。其他机器人编码器和完整尺寸图仍未完成。
catalogScope.en: Reviewed four EnDat3 ECI1319/EQI1331 items and accessories, 2021 KCI1319/KBI1335, 2023 KCI120/KBI136 and one KCI120 Dplus version. Other robotics encoders and complete dimensional drawings remain incomplete.

detail.zh: 创办金属蚀刻企业
detail.en: Metal-etching company founded

detail.zh: 在Traunreut重建公司
detail.en: Company restarted in Traunreut

detail.zh: 设立非营利基金会
detail.en: Nonprofit foundation established

title.en: Integrated into DIADUR SE holding structure

detail.zh: 纳入DIADUR SE控股架构
detail.en: Integrated into DIADUR SE holding structure

title.zh: 机器人编码器公开展示

detail.zh: automatica资料介绍KCI1300/KBI1300及面向较大机器人轴的感应编码器。
detail.en: automatica material presents KCI1300/KBI1300 and inductive encoders for larger robot axes.

overview.zh: Sumitomo Drive Technologies 的机器人相关产品包含Fine Cyclo精密减速器、伺服减速传动和smartris移动机器人轮驱动组合。其工业传动范围更大，本次不扩展矿业、水处理或一般大型齿轮箱目录。
overview.en: Robotics-related Sumitomo Drive Technologies products include Fine Cyclo precision reducers, servo transmissions and smartris mobile-robot wheel-drive packages. Its broader industrial transmission portfolio is not expanded into mining, water-treatment or general large-gearbox catalogs here.

overview.zh: Fine Cyclo的FC是无输出轴承减速组件，F1/F2/F3带不同轴承或轴结构，C强调中空通道，UA为两级高扭矩方案。相同尺寸编号不能跨结构借用重量、径向载荷或安装尺寸。
overview.en: Fine Cyclo FC is a reduction kit without output bearings; F1/F2/F3 use distinct bearing or shaft arrangements; C offers a hollow passage and UA uses two stages. Shared size numbers do not permit mass, radial loads or mounting dimensions to be copied between structures.

overview.zh: 官方精密传动手册记载Nagoya工厂1961年开始运营。上市母公司财务与传动品牌、机器人产品收入不是同一口径，本组不重复父任务已录入的2026上半年财务。
overview.en: The official precision-drive brochure records Nagoya factory operations beginning in 1961. Listed-parent financials, the drive brand and robotics-product revenue are different scopes; this group does not duplicate H1 2026 financials added by the parent task.

catalogScope.zh: 已登记Fine Cyclo T/W尺寸、ECY当前203/205/107及表列速比、IB P1/P2/PK1尺寸、smartris ECO/PRO电机与驱动器。其余精密选型、订货后缀和寿命图仍不完整。
catalogScope.en: Registered Fine Cyclo T/W sizes, current ECY203/205/107 and tabulated ratios, IB P1/P2/PK1 sizes and smartris ECO/PRO gearmotors and drives. Detailed selection, ordering suffixes and life curves remain incomplete.

detail.zh: 官方手册将Nagoya工厂的减速器和电机制造沿革追溯至1961年。
detail.en: The official brochure traces Nagoya reducer/motor factory operations to 1961.

overview.zh: Wiferion面向AGV、AMR和工业车辆提供无线充电、电池与改装集成方案。其目录既包含本方充电产品，也包含明确标注第三方品牌的电池配套。
overview.en: Wiferion provides wireless charging, batteries and retrofit integration for AGVs, AMRs and industrial vehicles. Its catalog includes its charging products and explicitly branded third-party batteries.

overview.zh: 2023年10月，PULS宣布收购Wiferion的经营业务，团队继续位于弗赖堡。该经营业务收购不等同于已核实所有历史法人或专利转移。
overview.en: In October 2023, PULS announced acquisition of Wiferion operating business, with the team remaining in Freiburg. This does not establish all historical legal-entity or patent transfers.

detail.zh: 公司历史页记录由Fraunhofer背景团队创立。
detail.en: The history page describes founders with a Fraunhofer background.

detail.zh: 公司历史页记录etaLINK获奖；属于公司公开历史，不作为性能保证。
detail.en: The company history records an etaLINK award; this is not a performance guarantee.

detail.zh: 公开新闻未列出本次收购价或独立营收。
detail.en: The announcement does not state a purchase price or standalone revenue.

overview.zh: 本次可核验材料主要是历史Gluon六轴机械臂及其QDD Lite关节的软件仓库。旧官网无法获得可读产品目录，因此这些记录描述文档所载历史产品，不代表当前仍可购买或企业经营状态已核实。
overview.en: The verifiable material in this review is chiefly historical repositories for the Gluon six-axis arm and QDD Lite joints. The old website yielded no readable catalog, so these entries describe documented historical products, not verified current availability or operating status.

detail.zh: 历史仓库列出机械臂规格和接线信息。
detail.en: The historical repository lists arm specifications and wiring.

overview.zh: MISUMI集团同时经营制造和流通业务。机器人相关范围包括单轴执行器及控制器、机械传动与结构部件、线缆和自动化配套；本组未把模具、非机器人切削刀具或其他无关目录混入。
overview.en: MISUMI Group combines manufacturing and distribution. Robotics-related scope includes single-axis actuators and controllers, motion and structural parts, cables and automation components; unrelated die and cutting-tool catalogs are not imported here.

overview.zh: 本次型号级深化以公开的美国RS控制器和配件历史目录为主。2025财年管理层说明列示集团合并营收441,383百万日元、营业利润47,613百万日元、归母净利润40,457百万日元；这不是RS产品收入。
overview.en: Model-level detail here chiefly uses historical public US RS controller and accessory catalogs. The FY2025 management message reports consolidated sales of JPY441,383 million, operating income of JPY47,613 million and profit attributable to owners of JPY40,457 million; these are not RS product revenues.

detail.zh: FY2025管理层说明称Fictiv自7月纳入合并；不据此推算交易价格。
detail.en: The FY2025 management message says Fictiv performance was consolidated from July; no deal price is inferred.

detail.zh: 从电子设备和轴承销售业务起步。
detail.en: Started with electronic equipment and bearing sales.

detail.zh: 成立MISUMI USA，拓展地区供应业务。
detail.en: Established MISUMI USA to expand regional supply operations.

detail.zh: 公开历史记录首本FA标准件目录。
detail.en: Public history records the FA standardized-parts catalog.

detail.zh: 将自动化电子部件纳入目录。
detail.en: Added electronic parts for factory automation.

detail.zh: 历史页记录在东证第二部上市。
detail.en: History records listing on the TSE second section.

detail.zh: 面向北美市场发布英制FA目录。
detail.en: Published an inch-based FA catalog for North America.

detail.zh: 通过换股整合，采用MISUMI Group名称；制造与流通并行。
detail.en: Integrated through a share exchange and adopted the MISUMI Group name, combining manufacturing and distribution.

detail.zh: 公司历史记录MISUMI Production Park成立。
detail.en: Company history records establishment of MISUMI Production Park.

detail.zh: 开始销售第三方品牌商品，不能把全部目录视为自制产品。
detail.en: Started third-party brand distribution; not every catalog product is internally manufactured.

detail.zh: 公司历史记录中国南通制造基地。
detail.en: Company history records a manufacturing site in Nantong, China.

detail.zh: 按东京证券交易所市场重组转入Prime市场。
detail.en: Transitioned under Tokyo Stock Exchange market restructuring.

detail.zh: 与Core Concept Technology合资成立。
detail.en: Joint venture with Core Concept Technology.

title.zh: KU寿命计算软件服务结束

detail.zh: 当前官方选型页公告该计算软件服务于该日结束，不表示KU机械产品停产。
detail.en: Current official selection page states that the calculation-software service ended on this date; this does not mean KU mechanical products were discontinued.

overview.zh: 实在智能的公开产品组合以企业级智能体、RPA设计执行调度、TARS模型、文档理解和数据采集为主。这里的“机器人”指软件流程机器人，不据此认定其供应机械臂、移动底盘或安全控制器。
overview.en: AI Indeed publicly offers enterprise agents, RPA design/execution/orchestration, TARS, document understanding and data collection. Its robots are software process bots, not evidence of arm, mobile-base or safety-controller production.

overview.zh: 公司自述于2018年3月22日在杭州成立。公开融资报道与客户案例保留为发行方陈述；本次未获得独立经审计营收或估值文件。
overview.en: The company states it was established in Hangzhou on March 22, 2018. Funding reports and customer cases remain issuer statements; no independently audited revenue or valuation document was obtained.

detail.zh: 公司简介给出成立日期与杭州总部。
detail.en: Company profile provides the founding date and Hangzhou headquarters.

detail.zh: 2023年融资报道回顾该次发布。
detail.en: The 2023 funding article retrospectively describes the release.

detail.zh: 文章称近2亿元人民币，由金泰富资本、安吉智慧谷领投，安吉两山国创跟投。该栏目带AI整理免责声明，未独立验证交割。
detail.en: Article reports nearly RMB200 million, led by Jintaifu Capital and Anji Smart Valley, with Anji Liangshan Guochuang participating. The page carries an AI-assembly disclaimer; closing was not independently verified.

title.zh: 企业级通用智能体发布

detail.zh: 沿用公开时间线中的发布日期，不重复其“行业首个”的比较性宣传。
detail.en: Uses the public timeline date without repeating its industry-first comparative claim.

overview.zh: Elmo开发伺服驱动器、多轴运动控制器、集成电机、配套电源及配置软件，公开目录区分工业和严苛环境，并保留Titanium、Platinum、Gold与SimplIQ代际。机器人集成需按具体电气配置、反馈和散热条件选择，而不是把各系列最优值拼成一台产品。
overview.en: Elmo develops servo drives, multi-axis controllers, integrated motors, supplies and configuration software. Its catalog separates industrial and harsh environments and Titanium, Platinum, Gold and SimplIQ generations. Robot integration requires exact electrical configurations, feedback and thermal conditions, not combinations of family maxima.

overview.zh: 公司总部位于以色列。当前公司介绍确认自2022年起属于Bosch Rexroth；本次未找到独立公开的Elmo营收或收购金额披露。
overview.en: Headquartered in Israel, the current company profile confirms Elmo has been part of Bosch Rexroth since 2022. This review did not locate standalone Elmo revenue or a disclosed purchase price.

detail.zh: 公开新闻介绍新一代安全伺服产品，不表示每个后续型号均获相同认证。
detail.en: The release introduces safety servo products; later models do not automatically inherit identical certification.

detail.zh: 公告描述签约和预期完成时间；当前公司介绍另确认2022年归属。
detail.en: Announcement concerns signing and expected completion; the current company profile separately confirms 2022 ownership.

detail.zh: SPS新闻公布新产品组合；是否供货仍按型号页确认。
detail.en: SPS announcement presents additions; availability remains model-specific.

detail.zh: 新增驱动器和控制器公开展示，型号参数以各自页面为准。
detail.en: New drives and controllers are publicly presented; parameters follow their respective pages.

overview.zh: PULS提供DIN导轨和分布式现场电源，并通过PULS Wireless经营Wiferion无线充电业务。本次型号级数据集中在FIEPOS目录中公开列出的现场电源，适配机器人工作站和分布式自动化供电。
overview.en: PULS provides DIN-rail and decentralized field supplies and operates Wiferion wireless charging through PULS Wireless. Model-level data here concentrates on public FIEPOS field supplies relevant to robot cells and distributed automation.

overview.zh: 2023年收购公告提到PULS集团2022年营业额2.5亿欧元。这是注明年份的集团历史值，不是当前收入，也不是Wiferion或FIEPOS收入；交易金额未披露。
overview.en: The 2023 acquisition announcement cites PULS Group turnover of EUR250 million in 2022. This is dated group-level history, not current revenue or Wiferion/FIEPOS revenue; deal value is not disclosed.

detail.zh: 经营业务形成PULS Wireless，团队留在弗赖堡。
detail.en: Operating business becomes PULS Wireless with the team in Freiburg.

overview.zh: Bassoon 为厂商公开目录中列出的伺服驱动器。以下规格按本页面或文档的型号及版本记录，不代表所有可订货选件。
overview.en: Bassoon is a servo drive listed in the manufacturer's public catalog. Specifications follow the model and document revision and do not establish every orderable option.

The negative potential of the outputs is permanently connected to PE within the unit. Do not connect any output to PE (Ground). The device is designed to supply any kind of loads, including capacitive and inductive loads. If capacitors with a capacitance > 20 mF are connected to the output, the unit might charge the capacitor in overcurrent mode. value.zh: typ. 42 A / 0 A At heavy overloads (when output voltage falls below 13 V), the power supply delivers continuous output current for 2 s. After this, the output is switched off for approx. 18 s before a new start attempt is automatically performed. This cycle is repeated as long as the overload exists. Once the overload has been cleared, the device will operate normally, see Fig. 6-2. Load impedance 10 mOhm. Discharge current of output capacitors is not included.

value.zh: typ. 7.5 A / 0 A At heavy overloads (when output voltage falls below 13 V), the power supply delivers continuous output current for 2 s. After this, the output is switched off for approx. 18 s before a new start attempt is automatically performed. This cycle is repeated as long as the overload exists. Once the overload has been cleared, the device will operate normally, see Fig. 7-2. Load impedance 10 mOhm. Discharge current of output capacitors is not included.

value.zh: typ. 42 A / 0 A continuous current, see Fig. 6-1 At heavy overloads (when output voltage falls below 13 V), the power supply delivers continuous output current for 2 s. After this, the output is switched off for approx. 18 s before a new start attempt is automatically performed. This cycle is repeated as long as the overload exists. Once the overload has been cleared, the device will operate normally, see Fig. 6-2. Load impedance 10 mOhm. Discharge current of output capacitors is not included.
